h1_ema_against.definition: EMA20<EMA50 for LONG; inverse SHORT; 50 closed H1 warmup

h1_momentum_against.definition: entry-direction H1 close change over 3 completed bars <0

h1_range_er12.definition: ER12<=0.25; abs net close change /sum 12 abs close changes

h1_previous_body_against.definition: latest CLOSED H1 body points opposite entry

h1_large_rejection_wick.definition: LONG upper wick/whole range>=0.5; SHORT lower wick inverse

h1_stretched_from_ema20.definition: entry >=1 H1 ATR14 beyond EMA20 in trade direction

h1_directional_outer_quartile24.definition: LONG last24 completed H1 position>=.75; SHORT<=.25

h1_directional_outer_quartile48.definition: LONG last48 completed H1 position>=.75; SHORT<=.25

h1_obstacle_inside1r.definition: nearest past known H1 swing high/low ahead lies within original 1R

h1_prior_level_retest5pct.definition: H1 prior high/low source before W1 origin is within .05*W1span of W1peak

h1_prior_retest_1r_target_conflict.definition: prior retest flag AND prior directional level distance from entry is (0,1R); v190 hypothetical

h1_log_structure_against.definition: existing log H1 structure AGAINST, only >=2 known H1 highs AND lows

h1_log_structure_range.definition: existing log H1_RANGE, only >=2 known H1 highs AND lows

h4_ema_against.definition: H4 EMA20/50 opposite entry; 50 full H4 warmup

h4_slope_against.definition: entry-direction H4 EMA20 change over3 full bars <0

prior_day_directional_outer_quartile.definition: entry directional position >=.75 in prior observed trade-day range
